|strategy=By Ryan Lobrano

A simple strategy with this card for those on the Light Side is to have it as your starting location. You can build up for your Starships' strength for less force than in other places, even though you don't get force drains. This can be easily remedied by those Dark Siders by placing the Dark Side [[Dantooine (Dark){{!}}Dantooine]] version of it on top.
